title: “The explanation makes sense”: An Empirical Study on LLM Performance in News Classification and its Influence on Judgment in Human-AI Collaborative Annotation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical performance of LLMs in classifying news media bias and the psychological impact of AI-generated explanations on human annotators. While it includes a brief section on ethical considerations regarding data use and model bias, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a primary research component.
